page_title: SEV 1-0 ATM | Sevilla v Atletico Madrid 11/02/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' That's the end of the match.
90+3' Marcos Acuna (Sevilla) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
90+2' The up-to-date shots on target statistics – 6:5.
90' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Atl. Madrid take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

88' Today's match ends for Djibril Sow who will be replaced by Joan Jordan (Sevilla).

84' Diego Simeone decides to make a substitution. Samuel Lino will be replaced by Rodrigo Riquelme (Atl. Madrid).

80' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Atl. Madrid comes to nothing.
78' Substitution. Erik Lamela (Sevilla) in, Isaac Romero out.

75' Rodrigo de Paul (Atl. Madrid) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
73' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Atl. Madrid.

64' Quique Sanchez Flores has decided to substitute Jesus Navas and he is replaced by Juanlu Sanchez (Sevilla).

60' A substitution has been made. Koke goes off and Angel Correa (Atl. Madrid) comes on.
58' Lucas Ocampos (Sevilla) has a goal ruled out for offside!
57' The resulting set piece from Atl. Madrid is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
56' Atl. Madrid have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
54' Marcos Acuna (Sevilla) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
52' Marcos Llorente (Atl. Madrid) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
50' Youssef En Nesyri (Sevilla) blasts the ball high over the crossbar.
48' Marcos Acuna (Sevilla) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
46' The game is over for Pablo Barrios. Nahuel Molina (Atl. Madrid) comes on for the second half.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Diego Simeone probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Alvaro Morata. He is replaced by Memphis Depay (Atl. Madrid).
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+5' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+1' Alvaro Morata (Atl. Madrid) picks up an injury.
45' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
44' Lucas Ocampos (Sevilla) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
42' The current number of shots on goal is 5:1.
40' Rough tackle by Marcos Acuna (Sevilla). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
38' Atl. Madrid are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
38' The corner is swung in but Sevilla can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
36' Marcos Acuna (Sevilla) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.

33' Isaac Romero (Sevilla) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Javier Iglesias Villanueva with no other option than to blow for a foul.
31' Marcos Acuna (Sevilla) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
28' OFF THE BAR! Isaac Romero (Sevilla) unleashes a thunderous effort from the edge of the box and the ball crashes off the woodwork. What a strike that was!
26' The game is interrupted because of a yellow card that is shown to Axel Witsel (Atl. Madrid).
24' Rodrigo de Paul (Atl. Madrid) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
22' Samuel Lino (Atl. Madrid) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and bends his effort inches wide of the left post.
20' The referee stops play as the linesman flags Alvaro Morata (Atl. Madrid) offside.
18' Mario Hermoso (Atl. Madrid) slams the ball goalwards from 50 metres out, but his decent effort flies a whisker over the crossbar.
15' 1 - 0 GOAL! The corner comes over and Lucas Ocampos wins a simple header before Isaac Romero (Sevilla) nods the ball into the back of the net. 1:0.
15' Sevilla force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
14' Djibril Sow (Sevilla) puts a cross into the box from the free kick, but the defender gets there first.
12' Atl. Madrid failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
11' Marcos Acuna (Sevilla) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
8' Jesus Navas (Sevilla) steadies himself and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the bottom left corner, but Jan Oblak has it covered and makes a comfortable save.
5' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Djibril Sow (Sevilla) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
4' Alvaro Morata (Atl. Madrid) is in a clear offside position and the referee blows his whistle after the linesman raises his flag.
3' Lucas Ocampos (Sevilla) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
